      (always "/pipeline-grouping").
    - annotations.yaml: Expected outcomes (expected_group_count, expected_jobs
      as comma-separated IDs, expected_grouping array of {root_cause, job_ids}).
    - _context/grouping-context.json: Job manifest table, expected job IDs,
      and Jira URL.

      - dedup-results.json: (conditional) Written only when groups match
        existing Jira tickets from recent-tickets.json.

  metrics: true
